A DPS Trooper stopped a vehicle in Val Verde County and found a 6-year-old boy unrestrained in the back seat, and his mother hidden in the trunk.

The driver, a human smuggler from Laredo, was arrested and faces felony smuggling charges. 

In Texas, we relentlessly hunt down smugglers.

posts.text:
One year ago today, more than 100 lives were cut short in Kerr County and even more across Central Texas due to devastating flash floods. 

Tonight, I joined the Symphony of the Hills and read the names of 119 lost souls. We must never forget them.

The Kerrville community rose from this tragedy the same way our nation has risen from every trial. 

That enduring spirit will ensure that our communities and our great nation will forever prevail.
posts.summary: Honors flood victims, emphasizes community resilience and disaster recovery
